KAREN_PROMISE_PILE.title: Promise Pile
KAREN_PROMISE_PILE.description:
A special pile unique to Karen Aijo.
The Promise Pile is ordered: cards put in first are drawn first.

KAREN_RETAIN_TMP_STRENGTH.title: Retain Strength
KAREN_RETAIN_TMP_STRENGTH.description: Extends how long Temporary Strength lasts.
KAREN_SHINE_CARD_REWARD.title: Shine Card Reward
KAREN_SHINE_CARD_REWARD.description: After combat, gain a card reward containing only 1 Shine card.
KAREN_DISABLE_RELIC.title: Disable Relic
KAREN_DISABLE_RELIC.description:
For one combat, disables the rightmost non-Ancient relic.
If there are no relics that can be disabled, this card [red]cannot be played[/red].
